rationale: Downside momentum has stalled over the last five 1-minute bars, with price repeatedly finding buyers at the $305.50–$305.57 level and failing to push through to the $304.50 take-profit target. Having captured roughly 76% of the original target move while the broader market remains very strong (SPY +2.35%), the remaining $1.30 of potential downside no longer justifies risking the $4.20 of accumulated unrealized profit. Closing now locks in a clean gain before a potential midday mean-reversion bounce back toward the 5-minute 9-EMA ($307.15).
